### Describe the Bug
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

### Steps to Reproduce

4. See error

A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

### Device Information

- **Android Version:** [e.g. Android 14 (API 34)]
- **App Version:** [e.g. v1.0.0]

### Additional Context & Logs
Add any other context about the problem here (e.g., error messages shown on screen).

> **Important Notice:** Do NOT file issues requesting circumvention of Digital Rights Management (DRM), decryption of paid streaming content, or private content. Media Downloader strictly supports non-DRM, public, or user-authorized content only.
